events.description: A conference among the US principals was called after news that UBL was at the habash house. The email says a missile attack that night was being seriously considered.
Email sent by the CIA author to Michael Scheuer with the subject 'Re: urgent re ubl'. The stamp says it was sent on 21 December 1998.
Principals' conference called after news that UBL was at the Habash house; a missile attack that night was being seriously considered.
Possible missile attack on UBL at the Habash house was under consideration, with the author's reservations noted.
Message sent, according to the document header.

relationships.detail: The US had been pressing the Taliban about UBL and said it would hold them responsible. This implies the Taliban hosted him. The text is fragmentary.
relationships.quote: have been hammering the Taliban on UBL & that we would hold .them responsible

relationships.detail: The author says the US has been pressing the Taliban over UBL and would hold them responsible; text is fragmentary.

relationships.detail: Implied: the Taliban are held responsible for UBL, which suggests they host him. Inferred from the demand to hold them responsible; the text is fragmentary.
Scheuer is the recipient of the CIA internal message.

key_claims: On 20 Dec 1998 US principals were seriously considering a missile attack on UBL after he was reported at the 'habash house'.
The US had pressed the Taliban on UBL and warned it would hold them responsible.
The author was not a hawk on bombing and noted that increased security raised the difficulty and danger of conducting the strike.
